title: Initialize Open and Closed Sets
description: Create an open set (priority queue) containing the start node with f-score = g + h, and an empty closed set for visited nodes. g(start) = 0, h(start) = heuristic estimate to goal.

title: Select Node with Lowest F-Score
description: Extract the node with the minimum f(n) = g(n) + h(n) from the open set, where g(n) is the actual cost from start and h(n) is the heuristic estimate to goal.

title: Check for Goal
description: If the selected node is the goal, reconstruct and return the optimal path by following parent pointers back to start.

title: Move to Closed Set
description: Add the current node to the closed set, indicating it has been fully processed and its optimal path from start is known.

title: Expand Neighbors
description: For each unvisited neighbor, calculate tentative g-score. If better than previously known, update g, f, and parent pointer. Add to open set if not already present.

title: Repeat or Report Failure
description: Continue until goal is found or open set is empty (no path exists).
